A [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During a training mission the Padawan was captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] slavers and taken to the hunter's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Wasskah/Legends|Wasskah]].<ref name="pl" /> around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="swa-2011" /> Once there, the Padawan was to be hunted by Trandoshan [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] and, while attempting to avoid the murders, was [[Death/Legends|killed]] there. [[Kalifa/Legends|Kalifa]], the leader of a group of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] hiding on the moon, later informed the newly arrived [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] about the Padawan's fate.<ref name="pl" />
